home.heroAlt: A bright, modern lab: students at workstations running chip-layout and circuit tools beside oscilloscopes, with a cleanroom behind glass.
home.heroUniversity: School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering - HUST
home.heroDesc: Research and graduate training in integrated circuit design, embedded systems and computer engineering.
home.aboutBody1: The IC design Lab at Hanoi University of Science and Technology conducts research and graduate training in integrated circuit design, embedded systems and computer engineering — spanning analog and mixed-signal design, digital and FPGA/ASIC implementation, and hardware for signal processing.
home.aboutBody2: The group publishes in peer-reviewed venues, supervises undergraduate and graduate theses, and collaborates with industry partners across Vietnam’s growing semiconductor sector.
